_meta.note: 0-5 per criterion for the 20-option shortlist. `tier` A = passed every hard filter. `tier` B = pay-as-you-go, carried forward deliberately because the report recommends them as overflow capacity behind a flat plan; they are scored under the same rubric but quota_value is fixed at 1 (you pay face value) and quota_ceiling at 5 (there is no ceiling), which is what pay-as-you-go means.

provenance.documented: the number is on the vendor's own pricing or docs page, read on 2026-08-27
provenance.derived: computed here from published rates — the arithmetic is in scripts/score.py comments or the report
provenance.judged: an assessment from documentation, third-party measurement and reported behaviour; not measured here

_meta.honesty: No benchmark was run for this study. Unlike research/agent-db-2026, every capability score here is documented or judged, never measured on this machine. Section 8 of REPORT.md says what that costs.
